dedupe_keys.name: grid singularity energy exchange simulation engine

description: Grid Singularity Energy Exchange is Grid Singularity's engine for simulating interconnected local electricity markets. Configured communities contain loads, generators and storage represented through trading strategies. The Python backend accepts simulation setups and timing options, then exports bids, offers, trades, asset energy balances and plots of prices or state of charge. Spatial coverage is the configured community network; the README demonstrates 15-second ticks, while run settings determine duration. Source is free under GPL-3.0 and includes command-line, Docker and testing instructions. A limitation is that economic trading outcomes depend on asset profiles and chosen market rules; they do not independently establish electrical feasibility. The README describes download-and-deploy functionality as forthcoming. The engine supports local-market and flexible-load simulations, complementing network calculations in OpenDSS (platform-opendss). Public result documentation was read, but no simulation or hosted account was used.
